dishes.name: Sunrise Spinach and Eggs
dishes.title: Pan-fried eggs with sautéed garlic spinach and toast
dishes.method: Fry the eggs in a little butter until the whites are set. Toast the bread and serve alongside a portion of the pre-prepared spinach.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-rich start to support muscle gain, featuring a loud vegetable.

dishes.name: Zesty Seed Butter Toast
dishes.title: Sunflower seed butter on toast with lemon zest
dishes.method: Toast the bread until golden. Spread generously with sunflower seed butter and top with fresh lemon zest.
dishes.why: I have substituted sunflower seed butter for the requested nut butter to keep the kitchen safe for the medical tree nut constraint.

dishes.name: Sunrise Spinach and Eggs
dishes.title: Pan-fried eggs with sautéed garlic spinach and toast
dishes.method: Fry the eggs in butter. Toast the bread and serve with the pre-prepared garlic spinach, ensuring the vegetables are placed on the plate first.
dishes.why: A high-protein breakfast that respects the house rule to avoid fennel and nuts.

dishes.name: Ginger Beef and Broccoli Bowl
dishes.title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry with steamed rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef stir-fry and rice in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Serve mixed together.
dishes.why: A large, starch-heavy lunch to support muscle gain with a loud, crunchy vegetable.

dishes.name: Ginger Beef and Broccoli Bowl
dishes.title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry with steamed rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef and rice in a pan. Plate the beef and rice first, then top with the broccoli.
dishes.why: High-protein lunch served in the specific order requested for Bertille.

dishes.name: Ginger Beef and Broccoli Bowl
dishes.title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry with steamed rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef and rice. Plate the broccoli first, followed by the beef and then the rice.
dishes.why: A nut-free stir-fry using fresh ginger for flavour instead of any restricted spices.

dishes.name: Golden Pan-Seared Salmon
dishes.title: Salmon fillets with smashed potatoes and green beans
dishes.method: Reheat the salmon, potatoes, and beans in a pan over medium heat. Serve with a squeeze of fresh lemon.
dishes.why: A warm, balanced dinner that avoids the broken oven by using the stovetop exclusively.

dishes.name: Golden Pan-Seared Salmon
dishes.title: Salmon fillets with smashed potatoes and green beans
dishes.method: Reheat all components in a pan. Plate the salmon and potatoes first, then add the green beans.
dishes.why: Stovetop dinner that respects Bertille's serving order and avoids celeriac.

dishes.name: Golden Pan-Seared Salmon
dishes.title: Salmon fillets with smashed potatoes and green beans
dishes.method: Reheat all components. Plate the green beans first, then the salmon, and finally the potatoes.
dishes.why: A safe, nut-free dinner featuring a loud vegetable and warm starch.

preparations.title: Sautéed Garlic Spinach
preparations.method: Sauté sliced garlic in oil until fragrant. Add spinach and cook until just wilted. Season with salt and pepper.

preparations.title: Ginger Beef and Broccoli Stir-fry
preparations.method: Heat oil in a large pan. Sear beef strips until browned. Add broccoli and grated ginger with soy sauce. Stir-fry until broccoli is tender-crisp.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in plenty of water until tender. Drain and fluff.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Salmon Fillets
preparations.method: Season salmon. Heat oil in a pan and sear salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook for 3-4 minutes until opaque.

preparations.title: Pan-Crisped Smashed Potatoes
preparations.method: Boil potatoes until soft. Drain, smash lightly with a fork, and pan-fry in oil until the edges are crispy.

preparations.title: Steamed Green Beans
preparations.method: Steam or boil green beans for 4-5 minutes until bright green and snappy.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice and potatoes boiling first. While they cook, chop the beef, broccoli, and ginger. Stir-fry the beef and broccoli in a large pan. Drain the potatoes, smash them, and crisp them in a pan with oil. Sear the salmon fillets. Finally, quickly sauté the spinach and steam the beans. Weigh and box everything immediately.
